import copy, json
from work import evaluate

def probe(label, request, evidence, policy, expected):
    original = copy.deepcopy((request, evidence, policy))
    actual = evaluate(request, evidence, policy)
    assert actual == expected, (label, actual, expected)
    assert (request, evidence, policy) == original, (label, 'mutation')
    print(json.dumps({'id': label, 'inputs': {'request': request, 'evidence': evidence, 'policy': policy}, 'expected': actual}, sort_keys=True))

probe('required-calibration-absent', {'claim':'rate','conditions':{'recipe':'R'}}, [{'source':'S','claim':'rate','value':0,'conditions':{'recipe':'R','calibration':0}}], {'required_conditions':['recipe','calibration']}, {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['calibration']})
